name: Piknik.Spot
description: Find local farms, bakeries, markets, shops, and restaurants. Ask in plain language. Browse surplus, wanted, and for-sale listings. Find public events. Find jobs and volunteer posts. Sign in for the extra skills on this agent.

skills.name: Search local food places
skills.description: Find farms, markets, shops, and restaurants. Example: bakery Waterloo.

skills.name: Get a public place summary
skills.description: Look up one public place by id or name.

skills.name: Search marketplace listings
skills.description: Browse surplus, wanted, and for-sale posts. Examples: surplus tomatoes; wanted eggs.

skills.name: Search jobs
skills.description: Find public jobs and volunteer posts.

bearer.description: Personal access token from Settings → Developer, or an OAuth access token.
